title: SAGE distributed multi-worker learning exhibit (public aggregate, v2 visual)

exhibit.purpose: Show parallel unsupervised-style workers exploring randomized stock geometry — a public-safe teaching analogue of large multi-bot simulation fleets, not a claim of 1000 physical robots.

what_is_shown: Many independent cells with seed-bound stock dimensions and shape classes
Staggered progress so the grid reads as concurrent learning, not a single path
WebGL metal teaching render with a CC BY 4.0 machine-shop panorama background
what_is_not_shown: Private fleet weights, training recipes, or raw episode corpora
Guaranteed transfer of synthetic gains to a specific machine
nonclaims: Not a thousand-bot NVIDIA marketing claim of identical scale
